job: In the CNC cell, wipe the coolant off the fixture table, then take the finished aluminium housing off the table and carry it out to the inspection cart by the roller door. The housing weighs about three and a half kilos.
understood_as: In the CNC cell, wipe the coolant off the fixture table, then lift the finished aluminium housing (about 3.5 kg) off the table and carry it out towards the inspection cart by the roller door.
steps: Wipe the coolant off the fixture table with a cloth.
Pick up the finished aluminium housing from the table.
Carry the housing out by the way out (the roller door) for the inspection cart.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and coverage for wiping coolant across the fixture table.
Shows how firmly to hold the cloth and press so it does not slip or bunch on the wet, oily surface.
Shows how a hand approaches, lifts and clears the housing from the fixture table without knocking the fixtures.
Shows how hard to pinch a 3.5 kg aluminium housing that may be slick with coolant, so it does not slip or get marked.

questions: The inspection cart has not been located in the scan. The plan only takes the housing out by the way out at the roller door. Can someone mark where the cart stands so the robot can set the housing on it?
Is the inspection cart inside the cell or just outside the roller door? That decides whether the housing really leaves the building or only moves within it.
